steps.description: Load the module, call createScene(), then immediately call updateMatrixWorld(true)

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Call root.updateMatrixWorld(true) immediately after createScene(). Without it, matrixWorld is stale and baked geometry will be wrong.

suggestions: const root = createScene(); root.updateMatrixWorld(true); — these two calls must be adjacent and in this order.

steps.description: Treat named THREE.Group nodes as parts/links — traverse to collect all named groups
Assign each mesh to its nearest named ancestor group
Bake world transforms: applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) then toNonIndexed()

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ The provided export_link_objs.mjs is missing toNonIndexed() after applyMatrix4(). Write your own baking code to avoid Chamfer distance errors >1.0.
❌ CRITICAL: After applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld), call toNonIndexed() if geom.index is set. Missing this causes OBJExporter to produce wrong vertex indices (Chamfer >1.0).
❌ CRITICAL: Do NOT clone meshes into a group for export. Bake geometry directly with applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) + toNonIndexed() then export.

suggestions: Baking pattern: let geom = mesh.geometry.clone(); geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld); if (geom.index) geom = geom.toNonIndexed();
warnings: Never skip toNonIndexed() — OBJExporter with indexed BufferGeometry silently produces wrong face indices, causing Chamfer distance >1.0.

steps.description: Export per-part OBJ using deterministic (sorted) part ordering

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Sort part names before iterating for export — unsorted iteration is non-deterministic and causes verifier failures.

suggestions: Sort by group name with localeCompare before exporting: parts.sort((a,b) => a.group.name.localeCompare(b.group.name)).
